objectives: "Industry 4.0 is the technology of the 4th industrial revolution. Manufacturing Execution System (MES) is the core system of automatic factories. MES will cover the functions of Complete Production Process Trace (Traceability), Full Production Information Monitoring (WIP Control), Equipment/ PLC Automatic Connectivity, Professional Quality Control System, Manufacturing Equipment Management, and Real-time Report. It will integrate robotic arms to meet the objective factory automated control by gaining massive data analysis in real time to improve the product quality and customer satisfaction as well as to reduce the production cost and maximize the benefit of enterprise. By the end of this course, participants are expected to select a specific topic concerning MES of Industry 4.0 for a deeper study and to write an academic paper."
